description:
Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
Runner 0.19.1 is a bug-fix release for macOS, Windows and Linux on top of 0.19.0.
New
- Start missions from the launcher. Mission shortcuts, the command palette, crew pages and the + on a project or Recents now open the launcher page: pick a crew, write an optional goal, and start in the selected project and folder. The New mission dialog is gone, and opening the launcher no longer creates an empty tab. A mission's title is the first line of its goal, or the crew and date. (#1097)
- runner mission start needs --title. Scripts and agents that start missions from the CLI now pass a title. (#1097)
- Messages reach Claude Code members mid-turn again. Since 0.19.0, every mission inbox notice waited until its member was Idle. Claude Code queues input typed during a turn, so a working Claude Code member now gets new messages straight away and reads them at its next step. Codex and the other runtimes still wait for Idle, and a draft or recent typing in the terminal still holds delivery. (#1103)
- Settings gear in the sidebar footer. The footer's account avatar is a Settings gear again: one click (or ⌘,) opens Settings, signed in or not. Sign-in and sign-out stay in Settings → Account. Settings → General → Local only is removed, so Account and Remote access are always listed; signing out now returns any window showing another computer to this one. (#1099)
Bug fixes
- Pressing Return in an idle agent no longer blocks its inbox. In 0.19.0, a Return that started no turn in an idle mission member's terminal, such as one on an empty composer, left the member Busy, and no further inbox notices reached it. Runner now returns it to Idle about 10 seconds after a submit that starts no turn. A notice still held behind a stuck Busy after two minutes posts a warning in the mission feed. (#1102)
- Resume keeps the conversation after an early exit. A resume that exits right away no longer clears the chat's conversation unless the runtime confirms the conversation is gone, so the next Resume tries the same one again. This mostly affected Codex. (#1028)
